parameter_refs.name: circulation_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: counterclockwise or clockwise original ring travel

quote: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: All vehicular travel shall be in a counterclockwise direction.

activation.condition: A motor vehicle travels within an actual roundabout.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Establish the original central island, circulatory roadway, entry geometry and Las Vegas jurisdiction.

timing.description: Observe actual circulation while the vehicle occupies the roundabout.
